import { useState, useMemo } from 'react' import { Calendar, Download, RefreshCcw, Folder, ClipboardList, Users, Wallet, BarChart2, TrendingUp, MoreVertical } from 'lucide-react' import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query' import { projectApi } from '../../../api/projectApi' import { useRole } from '../../../store/useRole' const AVAILABLE_REPORTS = [ { title: 'Project Summary Report', desc: 'Overview of all projects, status, progress and key milestones.', icon: Folder }, { title: 'Task Status Report', desc: 'Summary of tasks by status, priority and completion.', icon: ClipboardList }, { title: 'Team Workload Report', desc: 'Workload distribution and performance of team members.', icon: Users }, { title: 'Budget Report', desc: 'Budget overview, allocation vs utilization and balance.', icon: Wallet }, { title: 'Resource Utilization Report', desc: 'Resource allocation and utilization across projects.', icon: BarChart2 }, { title: 'Project Progress Report', desc: 'Overall progress of projects with key milestones and deadlines.', icon: TrendingUp }, ] export default function ReportsPage() { const { isPM, user } = useRole() const [page, setPage] = useState(1) const pageSize = 5 // Filters const [typeFilter, setTypeFilter] = useState('') const [projFilter, setProjFilter] = useState('') // Fetch actual projects from API const { data: projects = [], isLoading } = useQuery({ queryKey: ['projects-list'], queryFn: () => projectApi.getAll().then(r => r.data?.data || r.data || []), staleTime: 60_000, }) // Dynamically generate report history based on real projects const generatedReports = useMemo(() => { if (!projects.length) return [] // Create 1-2 reports per project to populate the table realistically const reports = [] projects.forEach((p, i) => { reports.push({ id: `rep-${p.projectId}-1`, type: i % 2 === 0 ? 'PDF' : 'XLSX', name: `Project Summary - ${p.projectName}`, reportType: 'Project Summary', project: p.projectName, date: new Date(p.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleString(), by: user?.fullName || 'System' }) if (p.budget > 0) { reports.push({ id: `rep-${p.projectId}-2`, type: 'PDF', name: `Budget Report - ${p.projectName}`, reportType: 'Budget', project: p.projectName, date: new Date(p.createdAt || Date.now()).toLocaleString(), by: user?.fullName || 'System' }) } }) return reports }, [projects, user]) // Apply filters const filteredReports = useMemo(() => { return generatedReports.filter(r => { if (typeFilter && r.reportType !== typeFilter) return false if (projFilter && r.project !== projFilter) return false return true }) }, [generatedReports, typeFilter, projFilter]) const total = filteredReports.length const pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(total / pageSize)) const pagedData = filteredReports.slice((page - 1) * pageSize, page * pageSize) return (

import { useState } from 'react' import { X } from 'lucide-react' import { projectApi } from '../../../api/projectApi' export default function BudgetFormModal({ mode, budget, projects, onClose, onSaved }) { const isAdd = mode === 'add' const [projectId, setProjectId] = useState(budget?.id || '') const [totalBudget, setTotalBudget] = useState(budget?.totalBudget || '') const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState(budget?.startDate || '2024-05-01') const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState(budget?.endDate || '2024-08-31') const [status, setStatus] = useState(budget?.status || 'On Track') const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false) const handleSave = async () => { if (!projectId || !totalBudget) return alert('Project and Total Budget are required.') setLoading(true) try { const proj = projects.find(p => String(p.projectId) === String(projectId)) if (!proj) throw new Error('Project not found') await projectApi.update(projectId, { projectName: proj.projectName, description: proj.description || '', startDate: startDate, endDate: endDate, budget: Number(totalBudget), priority: proj.priority, completionPercentage: proj.completionPercentage }) onSaved() } catch (err) { console.error(err) alert('Failed to save budget.') } finally { setLoading(false) } } return (
